title: Freshers Orientation Seminar
description: Welcome session for newly admitted students covering campus life, academic expectations, student support services, and an overview of PTI departments. Parents and guardians are welcome for the first hour.

title: Petroleum Engineering Guest Lecture
description: Industry experts from NNPC discuss modern drilling technologies, HSE practices, and career pathways for petroleum engineering students. Q&A and networking follow the talk.

title: Library Research Skills Workshop
description: Hands-on workshop on using the PTI digital library, academic databases, citation tools, and avoiding plagiarism. Bring your laptop if possible.

title: Campus Cultural Night
description: An evening of music, dance, drama, and fashion celebrating the diverse cultures of the PTI community. Food stalls open from 5 PM; main performances start at 7 PM.

title: SUG Meet & Greet
description: Informal hangout with Student Union executives. Share feedback, learn about upcoming initiatives, and meet course representatives from other departments.

title: Inter-Department Football Final
description: Championship match of the PTI inter-department football tournament. Come support your department — refreshments available at the sidelines.

title: Morning Fitness Bootcamp
description: Free outdoor fitness session for students and staff. Warm-up, cardio circuits, and cool-down stretches. Wear sportswear and bring a water bottle.

title: Table Tennis Open Day
description: Casual open play and mini-tournament brackets for beginners and intermediates. Rackets available to borrow; sign up at the indoor games hall on arrival.

title: Sunday Chapel Service
description: Weekly interdenominational worship service for the PTI community. All students and staff are welcome. Special choir performance this week.

title: Ramadan Iftar Gathering
description: Community iftar hosted by the Muslim Students Society. Fasting and non-fasting students are welcome. Please RSVP so catering can plan portions.

title: Electrical Dept Project Exhibition
description: Final-year and ND students showcase projects in power systems, electronics, and automation. Industry judges will award prizes for innovation and presentation.

title: Welding & Fabrication Skills Fair
description: Live demos, safety briefings, and employer booths focused on welding and fabrication career paths. PPE required for demo zones.

title: Computer Science Hack Night
description: Overnight coding sprint for CS and ICT students. Form teams of up to four, pick a campus problem, and build a prototype. Snacks provided; bring chargers.

title: Staff Development Briefing
description: Closed briefing for academic staff on the new semester calendar, exam moderation schedule, and LMS updates. Departmental HODs should attend or send a representative.

title: Alumni Mentorship Mixer
description: Past event for testing history views: PTI alumni met current students for career advice in oil & gas, manufacturing, and tech. Photos and notes are available from Student Affairs.
